author: terencechain
content: <@592004585506340885> <@425572898787426305> one thing i find odd in current pq spec is for non-pq validators at the pq fork boundary, we bypass normal exit churn and make them immediately withdrawalble unless they are slashed, but one could double vote right before the fork and get away before its slashing evidence gets included in the block. This is a very ugly problem because we also dont want to keep BLS slashing type in the post pq block

author: tcoratger
content:
What is planned for 0x0 validators? Just nothing? Because, as the PQ spec and EIP currently stand, my understanding is that a 0x0 validator cannot register their PQ material because they don't have a withdrawal address, and that's a requirement for registration. Even worse, if they do nothing at all before the cutoff and the PQ fork, their funds are lost because they don't have a withdrawal address to which they can be withdrawn.

So their only option for them right now is to switch to 0x1 or 0x2 before the cutoff, right?
